The images on show are of our real trees. Even with meticulous wrapping, each tree needs to be assembled correctly to get the desired look. First, assemble the tree foundation and then (if needed) install the lower section. Extend the branches of the upper portion down until you discover the electrical connection point. After the connection is completed, make sure the upper and lower electrical connections are in place before putting the top section of the tree into the lower pole (because 2ft, 3ft, and 4ft trees are all one-piece, this step is not required). If gaps are evident from different angles, raising the back branches relative to the front branches may help. This fills in the \"visual gaps\" without sacrificing the appearance of layers.
